module_summary: AXI4 DMA top: a structural wrapper pairing an independent read DMA (AXI memory to AXI stream) and write DMA (AXI stream to AXI memory), each driven by descriptor inputs and reporting status.

anchors.name: s_axis_read_desc_valid
anchors.why: Read descriptor submit into read DMA child.

anchors.name: s_axis_read_desc_addr
anchors.why: Source memory address of read descriptor.

anchors.name: m_axis_read_data_tdata
anchors.why: AXI stream output of data read from memory.

anchors.name: m_axis_read_data_tvalid
anchors.why: Read data stream valid from read DMA.

anchors.name: s_axis_write_desc_valid
anchors.why: Write descriptor submit into write DMA child.

anchors.name: s_axis_write_desc_addr
anchors.why: Destination memory address of write descriptor.

anchors.name: s_axis_write_data_tdata
anchors.why: AXI stream input data written to memory.

anchors.name: m_axi_araddr
anchors.why: AXI master read burst address from read DMA.

anchors.name: m_axi_rdata
anchors.why: AXI master read data returned to read DMA.

anchors.name: m_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: AXI master write burst address from write DMA.

anchors.name: m_axi_wdata
anchors.why: AXI master write data from write DMA.

anchors.name: s_axis_write_data_tvalid
anchors.why: Write data stream valid into write DMA.

anchors.name: m_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: AXI read address valid from read DMA.

anchors.name: m_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: AXI write address valid from write DMA.

anchors.name: write_abort
anchors.why: Aborts the current write DMA transfer.

groups.name: Read DMA engine
groups.description: axi_dma_rd child: descriptors to AXI read bursts, returned data to AXI stream.

groups.name: Write DMA engine
groups.description: axi_dma_wr child: AXI stream data written to memory as AXI write bursts.
